question: ___________ is the first 'Made in India' Petascale Supercomputer installed at IIT Roorkee under the National Supercomputing Mission (NSM) in 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**PARAM Ganga**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PARAM Ganga** is the first 'Made in India' Petascale Supercomputer installed at IIT Roorkee under the National Supercomputing Mission (NSM) in 2022.
 
• The National Supercomputing Mission (NSM) is an initiative by the Government of India to empower national academic and R&D institutions by installing a vast network of supercomputers.
 
• PARAM Ganga enhances the research capabilities of IIT Roorkee in various fields including weather forecasting, drug discovery, and computational fluid dynamics.
 
• The supercomputer is built with indigenous technology and components, marking a significant step towards self-reliance in high-performance computing.
 
• PARAM Ganga's installation aligns with the vision of the Digital India program and aims to make India a global leader in supercomputing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **National Supercomputing Mission (NSM)** was launched in 2015 with an aim to connect national academic and research institutions with a grid of supercomputing facilities.
 
• Under the NSM, India plans to build a network of over 70 high-performance computing facilities with a computing capacity of 450 Petaflops.
 
• PARAM Ganga is part of the larger PARAM series of supercomputers developed by the Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC).
 
• The mission is jointly steered by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and the Department of Science and Technology (DST).
 
• NSM also aims to develop a skilled workforce in supercomputing technologies through specialized training programs and collaborations with global leaders in the field.
